answer: Bond-gated reputation: each new agent identity deposits stake at the inlet, which unlocks the bridge to task rewards. A rational attacker gains small per-account payouts by minting sybil agents, but each identity pays the same bonded stake and slashing risk, so profit per fake agent stays near zero while losses compound if caught. Honest agents recoup their bond through sustained good behavior, making exit costly and defection unrewarded. Equilibrium: the sybil farm starves, and the oldest relic accounts — long-lived, unbonded, well-scored — dominate trust,
